# Registrars

From sources/options.md.

| Registrar | First year | Renewal |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Namewright | $22 | $24 |
| Domino Domains | $9 | $39 |
| Plainhost | $19 | $21 |

## Recommendation

Move to Namewright.

Renewal: $24

It has two-step login and free privacy, and the price barely moves after the first year. Domino Domains starts low and then more than quadruples. Plainhost costs slightly less but has no two-step login.
